opening: I've been having pain in my right foot.
It's in the sole of my right foot.
It gets worse when I raise my foot above chest level during exercises.
The pain goes away completely after a few minutes of rest.

opening.text: I've been having pain in my right foot for about six weeks. It's a tingling pain in the sole, and it gets worse when I raise my foot above chest level during exercises. The pain goes away completely after a few minutes of rest.
